name: The Ghostlight Express
summary: A black train on rails of mist, six haints, and a crash under a moon with a face.

stages.journal: A fiddle in the fog led us to a burying hill, a black train on rails of mist, and a frogman in a ragged hat who says we have tickets. It seems we do.
stages.hint: Talk to the Vagrant beside the train; find the tickets in your pockets, or let him point them out.

stages.journal: We are aboard the Ghostlight Express, in the rear car. The Vagrant talks to us through a brass grille in the ceiling: keep the doors shut, be polite to the pale passengers, and keep the Lord and Lady company.
stages.hint: Walk down the aisle to the front of the car.

stages.journal: A shade let the Shroud in, and one of the pale passengers went wrong with it. We drove them off. The Vagrant says six haints aboard are the easiest for the Shroud to sour, and that we should free them or put them down; then we are to look in the Tender, which unseals when they are gone.
objectives: Free or put down the six Wayward Haints
stages.hint: Walk the train. Each haint stays in its own car. Any grille in the ceiling will bring the Vagrant, with hints.

stages.journal: Six haints ride this train, each stuck on something unfinished. We can finish it for them, talk them round, bottle them or put them down.
stages.hint: Ask the Vagrant through a grille about any haint you have met.

stages.journal: The last haint is gone and the Tender's door has opened. The Vagrant asks us to look inside, and to be careful.
stages.hint: The Tender is the last car of the train; its door is on the far end of the last car.

stages.journal: The curse had reached the fuel. We killed what burst out of the firebox, and the train tore out of the Shroud and crashed in a dark wood, under a moon with a face. The Vagrant, the Lord and the Lady are alive.
stages.hint: The Vagrant is by the wrecked engine, east of where you landed.

stages.journal: The engine is pinned by black roots and has no fuel. The Vagrant has three of its six Soul Cans; three were thrown into the woods in the crash. They glow, so they cannot stay lost. A haint we bottled counts for one.
stages.hint: Look low, among roots, in the grooves' mist and under boulders. The Vagrant's fiddle will make them glow.

stages.journal: The Vagrant fed the cans to the firebox. The engine broke its roots and grew a face. It is hunting us, and eating the cans we scattered.
stages.hint: Smash the Soul Cans before the engine eats them; the clearing has cover and high ground.

stages.journal: The locomotive fell, and the train mended itself and left without us, the frogman waving his hat. The Lord and Lady, grateful, ask us to walk them to Wickermoor Village.
